statement:
(q : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ n, IsCauchy (q n)) (hx : ∀ n, x n = Real_of_CauSeq ⋯) (hxCau : IsCauchy x) :
  ∃ y, ∃ (hy : IsCauchy y), SeqLim x (Real_of_CauSeq hy)
name: Reals_are_Complete
content: The real numbers are complete; Cauchy sequences in the reals converge to a real number.
